Dose (oral solution):
0.12 mg bromazolam (3 drops)
0.16 mg bromazolam (4 drops)
0.24 mg bromazolam (6 drops)
0.24 mg bromazolam (6 drops)
Total 0.76 mg bromazolam (19 drops)
This is report of my first time using this substance.
Background: 45 yr old male with no benzo tolerance. I do not take any prescription medications and do not drink alcohol. No other substances were used on this day aside from two cups of coffee in the morning. My interest in this chemical is therapeutic in nature, not recreational. I am looking for something to reduce social anxiety but not put me to sleep like most other anxiety drugs.
Set and Setting: Home alone on a Friday night. I was in a good mood and looking forward to this experiment.
Experiment: I procured a bottle of bromazolam solution (not to be confused with bromazepam) off an online vendor. The bottle came with a 1-ml dropper, and indicated 2 mg per 1 ml of solution.
The bottle came with a 1-ml dropper, and indicated 2 mg per 1 ml of solution.
To determine potency of droplets, I pulled up a ml of solution and counted about 50 drops per ml, which would indicate each drop is ~0.04 mg of bromazolam. Ive read the potency is similar to alprazolam (Xanax), perhaps weaker, and decided to start small to make sure of no adverse reactions. Per tripsit.me, a light dose is 0.5-1 mg, common dose is 1-2 mg, and a strong dose is 2-4 mg+.
5:55 pm: Ingested 3 drops in a small amount of water for a total of about ~0.12 mg. This tiny dose was to make sure the potency wasnt too great and to make sure I didnt received the wrong solution or have any allergic responses.
7:00 pm: This hour went by quickly although I didnt have many noticeable effects. It was difficult to discern any anxiolytic effects. I took another 4 drops for a combined total of ~0.28 mg.
7:30 pm: Still didnt feel much although perhaps slightly more relaxed and sleepy. I took another 6 drops for a combined total of ~0.48 mg.
8:00 pm: I was feeling somewhat relaxed and decided to take another 6 drops before eating dinner. I didnt have much appetite but thought it would be best to eat. At this point I was feeling very lazy and getting tired quickly. The combined total after this last 6 drops was 19 drops ingested for ~0.76 mg of bromazolam.
8:15 pm: I quickly finished a small dinner and decided to go to bed as my legs were feeling weak and I was getting increasingly tired.
9:08 pm: I tried to watch some television in bed but couldnt keep my eyes open so I looked at the clock one last time and immediately fell asleep. I typical dont get sleepy until about 10:30/11:00 pm.
10:39 pm: Woke up to use the bathroom and stumbled my way across the hall. My legs were very weak and I went back to bed as quickly as I could.
7:45 am: Woke up after almost 11 hrs of sleep which is very uncommon for me. If I dont set an alarm I typically wake up after about 7-8 hrs.
Conclusion: I dont think this is something I would take in public at a party or business function, which was my intended purpose. The experience was relatively underwhelming and effects somewhat unnoticeable but then went very quickly to feeling weak and tired, even at the small doses I took.
Additional info (2/9/2025):
Ive since taken 5-6 drops of the solution a few times, or about 0.20-0.24 mg. It puts me to sleep quite well but other than that I dont see a use for it.
